The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `3000` (see `GrafanaBuilder.GrafanaPort`)
- Environment variable: `GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin` (see `GrafanaBuilder.WithUsername(string)`)
- Environment variable: `GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin` (see `GrafanaBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /api/health` to port `3000` is completed successfully.
